title: Mere Ghazi Kahan Ho
body:
(mere ghazi kahaan ho)
x2
(Teri jageer se, chal
<<MINI>>
para kaafla, mere ghazi kahaan ho) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
ay mere bawafa, hai bahan
berida, mere ghazi kahaan ho
Teri jageer se, chal
<<MINI>>
para kaafla, mere ghazi kahaan ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Tujhko dekhe bina, chayn ata
nahi
Noke neza pe sar tera
milta nahi Me ziyarat karun, kistarha ye bataa, mere ghazi kahaan ho Teri
<<MINI>>
jageer se, chal para kaafla, mere ghazi kahaan ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Khaak maqtal mere sar ka
parda bane, Hukm dedo zara, muntazir hai hawa, mere ghazi kahaan ho Teri jageer
<<MINI>>
se, chal para kaafla, mere ghazi kahaan ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Tere bazu mujhe raste me mile, Mene chadar samaj kar wo
sar par rakhe Bazuwo se tera, puchhti hu pata, mere ghazi kahaan ho Teri jageer
<<MINI>>
se, chal para kaafla, mere ghazi kahaan ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya haya agayi, chhup
gaye ho kidhar, Khud chali awungi, tum bataado zara, mere ghazi kahaan ho Teri
<<MINI>>
jageer se, chal para kaafla, mere ghazi kahaan ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Mene chalna sikhaya tha
bhayi tujhe Raah pur khaar par, mujhko chalna sikha, mere ghazi kahaan ho Teri
<<MINI>>
jageer se, chal para kaafla, mere ghazi kahaan ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Chalte naaqe se jab
khaak par ghir gayi Dekhti rehgayi, wo suwe alqama, mere ghazi kahaan ho Teri
<<MINI>>
jageer se, chal para kaafla, mere ghazi kahaan ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Berida bibiyon ki me
Abbas hu(n) Tum meri aas the, ay mere bawafa, mere ghazi kahaan ho Teri jageer
<<MINI>>
se, chal para kaafla, mere ghazi kahaan ho
<<DIVIDER>>
ehle
haider hu(n) qura(n) ki tafseer hu(n),koi "Yawar" nahi, kisko du me sadaa, mere ghazi kahaan ho
